title: IoT application for energy meters
summary: RaspberryPi-based IoT application that reads electricity, water and steam energy meters over RS-485 (Modbus RTU), piloted at the Athenian Brewery factory in Patras.
description: Application development on IoT devices (RaspberryPi based) for taking measurements from energy meters.
The devices communicate with energy meters (electricity, water, steam, etc.) using the RS-485 protocol (Modbus RTU).
It was applied in a pilot project of the IoT-Lab laboratory at the factory of the Athenian Brewery (Heineken) in Patras.
